bullish: On the 5m: price is above the NNFX Baseline MA and above session VWAP
Supertrend (10,3) is green / price is above the Supertrend line on the 5m
Hull Suite is in its bullish colour and sloping up
Trend Range Detector (Zeiierman) reads Trending, not Range
RSI(14) on 5m is between 50 and 75 (momentum up, not exhausted)
bearish: On the 5m: price is below the NNFX Baseline MA and below session VWAP
Supertrend (10,3) is red / price is below the Supertrend line on the 5m
Hull Suite is in its bearish colour and sloping down
Trend Range Detector (Zeiierman) reads Trending, not Range
RSI(14) on 5m is between 25 and 50 (momentum down, not exhausted)
neutral: Supertrend and Hull Suite disagree, or Hull Suite is flat
Price is chopping across the Baseline MA / VWAP on the 5m
Trend Range Detector reads Range, or price is inside the Support and Resistance band with no break

risk_rules: Only take trades where reward-to-risk is at least 2:1
Trade only in the direction of the 5m trend; no counter-trend intraday entries
No new entries in the first 15 minutes after the market open (09:15 IST for NSE, 09:00 IST for MCX GOLD)
NSE symbols: no new entries after 15:00 IST; square off all NSE intraday positions by 15:20 IST
MCX:GOLD1!: no new entries after 23:00 IST; square off by 23:30 IST
If I have 2 losing trades in a row, stop for the day
Reduce size or stand aside on weekly expiry day and around major events (RBI policy, Union Budget, US FOMC, US CPI / NFP)
notes: Add any other context you want Claude to factor in — e.g. macro events this week, key dates, anything that should affect your bias.

scan_logic.description: Intraday BUY/SELL/WAIT scanner. 5m trend/bias plus 3m confirmation, gated by genuine confluence across all 4 active chart indicators before any signal fires. 5m sets the directional bias; 3m must confirm before an actual BUY or SELL - a 3m confirmation failure is a watch (WAIT), never a trade, and the 3m timeframe can never override or flip an invalidated 5m bias. Every gate reads the last CLOSED candle on its timeframe, never the still-forming bar, so signals do not repaint. Scans the entire TradingView watchlist exactly as-is; no symbols removed or filtered. Active indicator set is the 4 indicators currently on the chart: Supertrend (primary trend gate on 5m, confirmation trigger on 3m), Session VWAP (directional confirmation), Relative Strength Index (14) on 5m (momentum confirmation / exhaustion filter, standard 30/70), and 'Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks' [LuxAlgo] (structural entry/stop/target). All other indicator references (Hull Suite, NNFX Baseline, EMA 9/21, CM_Ultimate_MA_MTF, Trend Range Detector, MA Cross Alert) remain removed from the gates below. If any indicator conflicts with the others, the scan returns WAIT. Supertrend, ATR(14), Wilder RSI(14) and session VWAP (hlc3, IST-session anchor), plus swing highs/lows and volume, are all computed from CLOSED OHLCV bars, not read from chart studies; only the Support/Resistance levels and a coarse Supertrend direction cross-check are read from chart indicators. Keeping the VWAP and RSI studies on the chart is optional (visual reference only).
active_indicators: Supertrend (10, hl2, 3) - primary trend gate on 5m, confirmation trigger on 3m
Session VWAP (hlc3, computed from closed OHLCV bars) - directional confirmation: price above VWAP required for BUY, below VWAP required for SELL
Wilder RSI(14) on 5m closed bars - momentum confirmation: blocks BUY when overbought (>=70), blocks SELL when oversold (<=30)
Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks [LuxAlgo] - structural entry, stop-loss and target levels

universe.source: current TradingView watchlist (live), scanned in full

NSE.applies_to: every NSE symbol in the universe

MCX_GOLD.notes: Normal closing/force-flat 23:30 IST. Elevated volatility ~18:00-21:30 IST around the US session and US data.

gate1_trend_5m.role: primary trend gate - sets the directional bias for the symbol
components: Supertrend (10, hl2, 3) on 5m, read on the last CLOSED bar: BULL if price is above the Supertrend line, BEAR if price is below it
gate1_trend_5m.bull: price is above the 5m Supertrend line on the last closed bar
gate1_trend_5m.bear: price is below the 5m Supertrend line on the last closed bar
gate1_trend_5m.wait: the 5m Supertrend flipped on the most recent closed bar (wait one bar for confirmation); a WAIT here stops the scan before the 3m stage so the lower timeframe can never trade against an invalidated 5m bias

gate2_confirm_3m.role: confirmation / trigger only - can confirm or withhold the 5m bias, never set or flip the trade direction
gate2_confirm_3m.direction: only in the direction of the 5m Supertrend trend; no counter-trend entries
gate2_confirm_3m.trigger: 3m Supertrend is aligned with the 5m trend direction (flipped into it on the last few bars, or already aligned) AND the last CLOSED 3m candle closes on the trend side of the 3m Supertrend line
gate2_confirm_3m.fail: if the 3m Supertrend is not aligned with the 5m trend, or the last closed 3m candle has not closed on the trend side of the 3m line, return WAIT (a watch, not a trade)
gate2_confirm_3m.pullback: prefer entries where price has pulled back toward the 3m Supertrend line within the last ~6 bars before the trigger, rather than entries far extended from it
gate2_confirm_3m.volume_bonus: trigger-candle volume >= 1.2x its 20-bar average (extra confluence, not required)

gate2b_vwap_confirmation.role: directional confirmation, not a standalone signal
gate2b_vwap_confirmation.indicator: session VWAP - hlc3, anchored to the IST session, computed from CLOSED 3m OHLCV bars through the last closed bar (falls back to an unweighted hlc3 mean for a symbol with no volume, e.g. a cash index)
gate2b_vwap_confirmation.bull_requirement: the last closed 3m price is above session VWAP for a BUY
gate2b_vwap_confirmation.bear_requirement: the last closed 3m price is below session VWAP for a SELL
gate2b_vwap_confirmation.fail: if price sits on the wrong side of VWAP for the trade direction implied by Gate 1/Gate 2, that is a conflict between Supertrend and VWAP - return WAIT

gate2c_rsi_confirmation.indicator: Wilder RSI(14) on 5m, computed from CLOSED 5m OHLCV bars and read at the last closed bar (not the chart study, which reports the still-forming bar)
gate2c_rsi_confirmation.fail: if RSI blocks the trade direction implied by Gate 1/Gate 2, that is a conflict between Supertrend and RSI momentum - return WAIT

gate3_risk.entry: close of the last CLOSED 3m trigger candle
gate3_risk.stop_loss: most recent CLOSED-3m swing low (BUY) or swing high (SELL), offset by 0.1x ATR buffer; clamp the entry-to-stop distance to [0.8x ATR, 2.5x ATR]; if outside that band, use 1.5x ATR instead
gate3_risk.risk_R: absolute distance from entry to stop-loss
gate3_risk.target: nearest structural Support/Resistance level in the trade direction, from the 'Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks' indicator
gate3_risk.insufficient_room: if the nearest structural target produces a final R/R below 2.0, return WAIT - do not widen, skip, or invent a target

scan_logic.decision: Return BUY or SELL only when Gate 1 (Supertrend 5m trend), Gate 2 (Supertrend 3m confirmation), Gate 2b (VWAP confirmation), Gate 2c (RSI momentum confirmation) and Gate 3 (S/R structural risk/target) all pass and agree on the same direction - genuine confluence across all 4 active indicators. The direction is fixed by the 5m trend; the 3m stage only confirms or withholds. If any gate fails, or any indicator conflicts with the trend direction (e.g. Supertrend bullish but price below VWAP, or RSI overbought/oversold against the trade), return WAIT with the specific failing reason.

alert_format.on_no_signal: WAIT plus the specific reason (which gate failed and why)
alert_format.example_signal: [SCAN 14:35 IST] RELIANCE1! - BUY | Entry 1,316.6 | Stop 1,308.4 (-8.2 pts, 1.4x ATR) | Target 1,333.0 (structural resistance from S&R Levels with Breaks) | R/R 1:2.0 | Reasons: 5m trend BULL - price above the 5m Supertrend line on the last closed bar; 3m confirm - 3m Supertrend aligned green and the last closed 3m candle closed above it; volume 1.4x avg
alert_format.example_wait: [SCAN 22:10 IST] GOLD1! - WAIT | Inside MCX session, 5m trend BEAR, but the 3m Supertrend has not aligned down -> watch, no confirmed entry
alert_format.telegram: Only confirmed BUY / SELL lines are forwarded to Telegram by notify-telegram.js; every WAIT / watch line is logged and journaled only, never sent.

scan_logic.inherits_risk_rules: All entries in risk_rules still apply. The 'reward-to-risk at least 2:1' rule matches scan_logic min_risk_reward of 2.0. Also enforced: no new signals in the first 15 minutes after each market's open, maximum 2 open positions, and stop for the day after 2 consecutive losing trades.
